AWAKENING.title: Awakening
AWAKENING.description: Triggers if you have at least 3 Energy when this card is played.
EMBER.title: Ember
EMBER.description: Each stack makes the owner take +1 damage from attacks. Every 5 stacks, immediately lose 5% max HP. At end of turn, halve stacks.
QI.title: Qi
QI.description: Its stat bonus depends on stance: Attack grants Strength, Guard grants Dexterity.
QI_GAUGE.title: Qi Gauge
QI_GAUGE.description: Gain Qi Gauge when your attacks hit or when you are hit. Reaching the threshold grants 1 [gold]Qi[/gold].
QI_CONSUME.title: Qi Cost
QI_CONSUME.description: This effect consumes Qi. If you do not have enough Qi, it cannot be played or the Qi-cost effect will not trigger.
XIANGZU_LEGACY.title: Legacy of the Aroma Clan
XIANGZU_LEGACY.description: Whenever your attack hits or you are hit, [gold]Qi Gauge[/gold] +1.
